purpose: Per-place breadth and variety bars the place-build skill and the compile's 0098 check read (16k slice 1b, decision 0100 decision 7). Tiers are the catalogue magnitude; M4 and M5 are city bars counted per culture quarter. Every number carries its source. Read through tooling/world-generation/worldgen/breadth_bars.py (bars_for).

fieldNotes.groundKindsMin: distinct surface materials in the place, path paint kinds included
fieldNotes.lightKindsMin: distinct man-made light fixture kinds; 0 is allowed only for a place whose catalogue record says it is unlit at night and why
fieldNotes.dressingAssetShareMax: the largest share any one dressing asset may take of the place's dressing pieces
fieldNotes.defaultTier: used only when a record carries no magnitude; the record's classification.magnitude decides otherwise
fieldNotes.buildingSpacingM: [min, max] metres between neighbouring buildings; 97 C6 buffers each district hull by half the max
fieldNotes.densityPerHa: [low, high] 97 C6 band: counted buildings and structures per hectare of the union of the district hulls, read from the column the place is built under
fieldNotes.dressingPiecesPerDwellingWithin12mMin: every placement within 12 m in plan of the dwelling's footprint (15 m in height of its anchor), except shells, pads, ground treatments, modular-run pieces, natural references (trees, rocks, wild plants: the frozen world's layer) and markers; crops, steps, porches, doors, smoke, fire and clutter count (decision 0105 R6 and R33); p50 over the place's dwellings; the values are the vanilla R6 p50s of r33-dressing-count.md rounded down to 5
